svg.title: Security zones and conduits of WP-C-07
svg.desc: Five security zones: the site network, the robot compute, motion control, the safety chain and the development, supply and maintenance zone, with the conduits between them. The safety chain has no data conduit in; it reports one way to motion control and is configured only at commissioning.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 4-1 Security zones and conduits of the robot (IEC 62443-3-2 ZCR 3)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5 zones, 6 conduits. No conduit from the network reaches the safety chain: it reports one way and is configured only at commissioning
